result.target_topic: Litigation Outcome for California and First Texas Case Patents

comparisons.peer_topic: Netlist E.D. Tex. litigation verdict and PTAB proceedings
comparisons.peer_summary: In Netlist's E.D. Tex. litigation, a jury found Micron liable for infringing two patents, awarding $425 million and $20 million in damages, respectively; Micron intends to appeal, though the PTAB found the asserted claims unpatentable.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclosed specific outcomes in 2024 regarding patent infringement litigation in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, though the results were opposite. Intel reported prevailing on all patents in a related California case with final judgment entered, whereas Micron reported an adverse jury verdict finding liability and awarding significant damages ($425 million and $20 million) in its E.D. Tex. litigation with Netlist, which Micron intended to appeal.

sentences.text: Intel prevailed on all eight patents and the court entered final judgment in April 2024.

On May 23, 2024, following a four-day trial regarding the second complaint filed by Netlist in the E.D. Tex., a jury rendered a verdict that Micron's memory modules infringe two asserted patents - U.S. Patent No. 7,619,912 ("the '912 patent") and U.S. Patent No. 11,093,417 ("the '417 patent") - and found that Micron should pay $425 million for infringement of the '912 patent and $20 million for infringement of the '417 patent.

comparisons.peer_summary: Sonrai Memory filed a patent infringement complaint against Micron regarding SSD and NAND products, which was dismissed by the court on September 6, 2024, pursuant to a joint motion.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclosed significant legal proceedings in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas concerning patent infringement claims from NXP-acquired patents. Intel prevailed in this specific Texas case, with the Federal Circuit reversing a $675 million award and affirming infringement on a separate patent, while Micron's similar litigation in the Western District of Texas with Sonrai Memory was dismissed via joint motion.

sentences.text: VLSI appealed the Court's judgment of non-infringement as to one of the eight patents.

In April 2019, VLSI filed three infringement suits against us in the US District Court for the Western District of Texas accusing various of our processors of infringement of eight additional patents it had acquired from NXP:
On August 16, 2022, Sonrai Memory Ltd. filed a patent infringement complaint against Micron in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas.
On September 6, 2024, pursuant to a motion jointly filed by the parties, the court dismissed Sonrai's complaint.
